content:
I've drafted a Tau Ceti roadmap for random measures and point processes, and I wanted to make the Brownian Motion project aware of it. One goal of the draft is to avoid clashing with the aims of this project.

The roadmap covers generalized Poisson processes, Palm measures, Cox processes, compensators, time change, culminating in the linear Hawkes process. (If Tau Ceti discussions should be limited to the Tau Ceti project, I apologize for the spam)

As written, it doesn't defines or uses the Itô integral, a Doob–Meyer decomposition, or a bracket. All the integrals are pathwise Lebesgue–Stieltjes integrals against a point measure. A compensator is defined by the integral identity against predictable integrands and constructed only for internal histories via the hazard formula. General-filtration existence comes from this project's Doob-Meyer. It uses Filtration.predictable, IsStronglyPredictable, IsRightContinuous, and Locally from Mathlib. I structured the coordination paragraph to avoid Brownian Motion, the most adjacent parts of the theory are Layers 10–11. Please tell me whether that boundary matches this project's plans and whether any of it collides. I'm happy to redraft.

https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCetiRoadmap/pull/417
